programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import Counter
\ndef transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, x in enumerate(row) if x != bg]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if (r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)) and grid[r][c] == bg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
